rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken pattern for “after” or “following” a time, event, or action.

example.english: Following dinner, let’s go see a movie.
example.traditional: 食完飯之後，我哋去睇戲啦。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tai2 hei3 laa1

rows.note: Use this everyday pattern for the next item, section, or time period; it is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: We’ll hold the meeting the following week.
example.traditional: 下個星期我哋先至開會。
example.jyutping: haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 ngo5 dei6 sin1 zi3 hoi1 wui2

rows.note: Use this written label before material that is about to be listed, rather than for an ordinary next item.

example.english: The following is the agenda for this meeting.
example.traditional: 以下係今次會議嘅議程。
example.jyutping: ji5 haa6 hai6 gam1 ci3 wui6 ji5 ge3 ji5 cing4
